premises.text: Ordinary conversations fail when people lack timely facts about people, news, and places while holding smart devices
premises.evidence_span: I look like an idiot and Brett is frustrated because I forgot that he was on vacation

premises.text: MindMeld is a voice/video calling app that understands conversation and surfaces relevant information for sharing in a real-time workspace
premises.evidence_span: the first voice and video calling app that actually understands what you say in order to put relevant information right at your fingertips

premises.text: An anticipatory computing engine models the last minutes of conversation to proactively find relevant web information for the next moments
premises.evidence_span: it analyzes the last 10 minutes of your conversation to anticipate what you might need in the next 10 seconds

premises.text: A developer platform will let third parties build other continuous-attention intelligent applications on the same technology
premises.evidence_span: we're opening up our developer platform early next year

value.text: Devices continuously anticipate and supply the information people need in conversation
value.evidence_span: better anticipate the information that we might need

causal_links.evidence_span: make painful conversations like this one a thing of the past
I've got all the facts at my fingertips right now because of MindMeld
developers and third parties can build new applications that take advantage of this powerful technology
